original_name: アリスティーネ・ミ・ロシエル
source:
[u][b]The Cheerful High Elf Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: High Elf (Alternia Tribe)
Second Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy
Super Tech Secret Swimming Club Member

A Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy second-year student. A girl of the High Elf race. She has a bright, straightforward, and extremely positive personality, overflowing with energy. She is very sociable and has many friends.

Although she has a "dog-and-monkey" relationship with the Dark Elf, [url=/c146730]Raelda[/url], they are also close friends. (She often teaches Raelda how to study.)

She had met the protagonist outside in his world in the past, and at that time, after being rescued while injured, she began to like him. (When she was little, she was playing with Raelda, got caught in a trap, and Raelda failed to disarm it. She was sent to the world where the protagonist lived. At that time, due to the trap's effect, she appeared in the form of a small rabbit.) Meeting the protagonist again in her world, she feels that this could be destiny and strongly wishes to repay the favor.

She loves the protagonist 120% and, with her voluptuously developing lewd body, frequently initiates planned but unconscious skinship. (Using devilish skinship to try to break the protagonist's self-control.) She often speaks to him in a teasing tone.

Contrary to her appearance, her academic performance is excellent, ranking in the top 5 of her grade. However, her actions are often impulsive and reckless without thinking ahead.

She belongs to the Super Tech Secret Swimming Club  (Super Tech = Super Swimming Techniques).

Her hobbies are knitting and making sweets, her feminine skills being quite high. She is not good with scary stories, ghosts, or spirits.
